sentences.sentence: What would you wish for if you had a magic lamp?
If I found a magic lamp, I would wish for a new pet.
If I had new markers, I could draw beautiful pictures with every color.
It would be fantastic if I had an adorable little rabbit.
Best of all, I would wish for a time machine.
I could go back in time and get piano lessons from Beethoven.
These are the wishes I would make if I found a magic lamp.
Have you ever thought about what you would wish for?
